evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: These evidence sources are heterogeneous and individually incomplete: documentation describes tables and interfaces but omits task-level coordination, expert CASE records expose multi-table modification patterns without explicit schema grounding, and execution feedback reveals latent constraints only when a plan is executed.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: We evaluate \textsc{SkillRefine} on PIMS-Bench, a benchmark built from two AspenTech PIMS demonstration models, using disjoint construction and held-out test tasks.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: On the held-out test set, \textsc{SkillRefine} achieves absolute component match F1 gains of 14\%--30\% across four LLM backbones, with the largest gains on complex multi-table coordination tasks.
